data_class: measurement on exclusively leased Vast RTX 4090 with pinned campaign kernels

device.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
device.resource_note: The 0.5 s telemetry is sampled concurrently; observed peaks may miss between-sample maxima. Polling impact was not measured independently.

sampling_work_outside_batch_clock.scope_note: Timed wall runs from the selected scheduler call through all three native updates. The host census, skipped schedule traversal, context restoration, finite gate, GPU diagnostic readback, post-sample replay, and logging are separate. Skipped traversal and logging do not have independent timers.

estimates.method: For each stratum, multiply the mean sampled full-launch time by its full-launch population. Keep launch 1 as a certainty of weight 1, and use the other three observations to estimate its stratum's remaining population. Project later epochs by repeating the first-epoch launch population and measured stage rates.
estimates.units: All estimated totals are the contribution of the 3,602 full-size R launches; single-arm equivalent is shared materialization plus the seed-1 arm.
assumptions: The four ranked strata condition on strict-slide fraction and clipped depth, and each measured batch used the original canonical/random coordinate draws for its ordinal.
Measured work follows sixteen native updates rather than a full learning trajectory. Different roots and improving-coordinate sets can change joint verification frequency and GPU workload.
A late sampled batch follows causal snapshot restoration. Locality, contention and thermal conditions can differ during uninterrupted training.
The one leased RTX 4090 measurement reflects its device/host/clock conditions. Treat cross-host and repeated-epoch extrapolations as planning estimates.
Rates for the 1,722 partial and tail launches, DEV-tune baseline/sweeps, convergence, sealed validation and full uninterrupted campaign wall remain unknown.
estimates.observed_rate_bracket_note: Uses the minimum and maximum observed wall in each randomly sampled group for its remaining population. It is a sensitivity bracket, not an error bound or confidence interval.

wick_official_campaign.status: no source-bound training timing receipt at passive readback
wick_official_campaign.disposition: No exit status or cause was available in the inspected receipts.

quantile_conventions.window_depth: Nearest rank using ceiling(p times target count) over exact histogram.
quantile_conventions.time_and_resource: Linear interpolation between adjacent ranked observations at index p times (n minus 1).
